Vlasta Kabeláč Čiháček's report from the exhibition in Rakovník, where he, Lukáš Valný and Martin Šimůnek fell victim to a downhillers' conspiracy 🙂

"Rakovnické cyklování is one of the big cycling events, normally allowing riders to start in 7 disciplines – from XC to the Downtown urban downhill. Unfortunately the coronavirus affected events like this too, so the organiser had to keep participant numbers down. Anyway, the event went ahead, and a day full of action awaited me, Martin Šimůnek and Lukáš Valný. 

Originally we only went for 3 exhibition shows, and in the gap between the 2nd and 3rd we planned to test the local trails. It all ended differently – after we tried the footbridge over the local lake, where a crossing race was to take place the next day, the organisers of the downhill part offered us a ride in the exhibition downhill race instead of the trails. None of us had ever ridden downhill, and since the course was short and had no jumps, we said why not. The organisers even moved the start for us so we could make our last exhibition show.

Practice was great, and the tight corners probably gave us a bit of an advantage, because anyone who could get through on the front wheel gained a lot. It was practically a pure technique downhill. Based on practice I personally thought Lukáš Valný would be on the podium, but what do I know. Martin Šimůnek's 10-year-old Remedy is a bit worn out, and he was a bit out of place on 26”, but…. A race is a race and Martin has it in his blood. Without a front brake he still took 8th place out of 15 riders. Lukáš Valný was second after the first run but finished 4th in the end. At the awards ceremony we had long since changed and were practising back on our Trial bikes (it takes a moment to get used to them again), so we found it strange that they were calling us to the podium. The announcement of the downhill winner was a bit of a shock for everyone, including me. I was the only one who somehow got under 20 seconds, and with a relaxed ride I won. At first I thought they were joking (it would be just like the guys), but after checking the results I went up on the podium for the diploma. So among my dreams come true, besides Trial titles, I can now tick off a win in a DH race :D Here's to chance and Trial skills."
